question.instructions: Does the note rely mainly on generic, commonplace fruit descriptors (like cherry, berry, plum, apple) without any distinctive or unusual character notes?

criteria.true: The note states this or clearly implies it
criteria.false: The note gives no indication of this

standard_answer.note:
虽然提到了 plums、apricots、apple 这些常见水果描述，但同时还有：
- yeast
- maturity
- dense, complex structure
- tight apple skin finish
因此并不是“主要依赖普通水果描述，且没有其他独特特征”。
